name: Zenithal-Astrolabe
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws massive canyon systems, patient as erosion itself.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.

The terrain around the starship crash site (colony ship) is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
Relatives of the lost still charter quiet ships to fly the debris fan. Sometimes they hire escorts. Sometimes they need them.
